summary: Verify the CMSIS tools environment exported by the CMSIS Solution extension, CMSIS-Toolbox, CMake, Ninja, and available compiler toolchains, and return a `PASS` or `FAIL` report without installing or reconfiguring tools.
unmapped: CMSIS Solution extension (arm.cmsis-csolution), optional discovery source
Arm Tools Environment Manager, optional discovery source
verification: Confirm `cbuild`, CMake, Ninja, and the required compiler toolchain through the listed `cbuild` commands.
Resolve the effective `cbuild` executable and run `cbuild --version`. Confirm that the command succeeds and record both its path and reported CMSIS-Toolbox version.
When the generated file lists CMSIS-Toolbox, confirm that the effective executable comes from its selected directory and that the reported version matches the listed version.
Run `cbuild list environment`. Record the reported environment and confirm that CMake and Ninja are both found.
Run `cbuild list toolchains`. Record every detected compiler identifier and version. Use `cbuild list toolchains --verbose` to verify compiler paths and registration variables.
Return `PASS` only when `cbuild` is available, CMake and Ninja are found, and at least one compiler toolchain is detected.
When the generated environment identifies a compiler through `tools` or a compiler registration variable, also require `cbuild list toolchains` to report that compiler and version.
When the manifest fallback is used and requests a compiler, require the reported compiler and version to match that request.
stop_conditions: Stop when YAML parsing fails or any consumed field has the wrong structure.
Stop when it resolves outside the workspace, does not exist, or identifies a different solution.
Stop on a missing path or tool directory.
Stop when an artifact is absent or when its location is ambiguous.
Stop when multiple extension installations make the selection ambiguous.
When CMake or Ninja is missing, return `FAIL` and recommend that the user set up the build environment outside this skill.
When no compiler is detected, return `FAIL` and recommend that the user set up a compiler outside this skill.
When a requested vcpkg artifact is not already installed, return `FAIL` and ask the user to activate or repair the workspace environment outside this skill.

When `.cmsis/tools-environment.yml` has structural errors in fields consumed by this skill, is stale, or references missing paths, return `FAIL` and ask the user to convert the solution or reactivate the tools environment in the CMSIS Solution extension.
Stop when a selected artifact is absent or ambiguous, `cbuild` is unavailable, or a required environment check fails.

rules.delta: artifact locations, tool versions, compiler registrations, or command results
Do not add persistent host settings … beyond the artifacts selected by the workspace.
Verify the existing environment only; … update, repair, or reconfigure tools.

extracted.title: Structure of the generated .cmsis/tools-environment.yml
extracted.body: Require one `cmsis-tools-environment` mapping containing string `version`, `generated-by`, and `solution` values; an `environment` mapping with a string array `path` and a string-to-string mapping `variables`; and a `tools` array whose consumed entries contain string `name`, `origin`, and `directory` values plus a `provider` mapping.

extracted.title: Import the generated CMSIS tools environment process-locally
extracted.body:
Treat `environment.path`, `environment.variables`, and `tools` as the extension-resolved source of truth. Do not rediscover precedence from the vcpkg artifact store or choose another installation when this file is valid.

Prepend the listed `environment.path` entries to the current process `PATH` in their listed order, preserving their precedence, and export every `environment.variables` entry process-locally. Do not persist variables or edit the generated file; the CMSIS Solution extension is its sole writer.

extracted.title: CMSIS-Toolbox compiler registration variable
extracted.body: Export the CMSIS-Toolbox registration variable for each compiler using its family and normalized version, for example `GCC_TOOLCHAIN_15_3_1=<artifact>/bin` for GCC 15.3.1.

extracted.title: CMSIS_COMPILER_ROOT belongs to the selected CMSIS-Toolbox
extracted.body: Set `CMSIS_COMPILER_ROOT` to the `etc` directory belonging to the selected CMSIS-Toolbox. Do not combine a `cbuild` executable with another CMSIS-Toolbox installation's configuration directory.

extracted.title: Arm Tools Environment Manager activation is not inherited by other processes
extracted.body: Arm Tools Environment Manager activation is local to its VS Code instance and is not inherited by every shell or agent process.
